title: 1996 AHSME Problem 2
statement: Each day Walter gets \(\$3\) for doing his chores or \(\$5\) for doing them exceptionally well. After \(10\) days of doing his chores daily, Walter has received a total of \(\$36.\) On how many days did Walter do them exceptionally well?

solutions.text: Ten ordinary days would pay \(10\cdot3=30\) dollars. Each exceptional day adds \(5-3=2\) dollars, and the actual total is \(6\) dollars higher. Thus there were \(\frac{6}{2}=3\) exceptional days, so the correct answer is A.
hints: Begin with the amount Walter would earn at the ordinary rate on all ten days
Each exceptionally good day adds the same amount to that baseline
